stories.title: PCA Joins the 40-40 Club — Historic Achievement
stories.angle: Pete Crow-Armstrong became the 7th player in MLB history to hit 40-40 with his 40th stolen base in the 1st inning vs Marlins on Sept 24. Season: 45 HR / 40 SB. First-ever 40-40 Cub. NL MVP frontrunner. "M-V-P!" chants during clinch celebration.

x_posts.text:
45 home runs. 40 stolen bases. Pete Crow-Armstrong just joined the 40-40 club — 7th player in MLB history.

No Cub has EVER done this. "M-V-P!" chants filled Wrigley during Thursday's clinch. The NL isn't ready for this guy. 🔥

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs
